# SEC EDGAR MCP

> SEC EDGAR filings, 10-K/8-K reader, XBRL financial facts, Form 4 insider trades

This MCP server exposes 6 tools via the Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST). It runs on Cloudflare Workers and is billed via Dodo Payments. Authenticated via `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` obtained by subscribing at `https://sec-edgar-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/upgrade`.

## Endpoint
- MCP JSON-RPC: https://sec-edgar-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/mcp
- Health: https://sec-edgar-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/health
- Landing page: https://sec-edgar-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/
- Get API key: https://sec-edgar-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/upgrade?tier=solo

## Tools
- `edgar_search_filings`: Search recent filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, S-1, Form 4) by ticker or CIK with form-type / date filters.
- `edgar_read_filing`: Fetch full HTML text of a specific filing by accession number (truncated at ~80K chars).
- `edgar_get_facts`: XBRL-structured financial facts: revenue, EPS, cash, net income. Accepts aliases or us-gaap concepts.
- `edgar_get_8k`: Recent 8-K material events with classified event types (acquisitions, exec changes, auditor changes, etc.).
- `edgar_get_company`: Company metadata: legal name, SIC industry, exchanges listed, fiscal year end.
- `edgar_get_insider_trades`: Form 4 insider-trading filings (officers, directors, 10% owners) with buy/sell direction.

## Authentication
Pass `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` on POST /mcp. Free tier: anonymous, 100 calls / month / IP.

## Pricing
- Free: 100 calls / month (anonymous, no signup)
- Solo $9/mo: 2,000 calls / month, 60/min
- Team $29/mo: 10,000 calls / month, 200/min, 5 team seats
- Pro $79/mo: 50,000 calls / month, 600/min, 25 team seats
Billed via Dodo Payments (merchant-of-record). Cancel anytime.

## Account management

- GDPR data export: GET https://sec-edgar-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/export (Bearer)
- Team management (Team+): https://sec-edgar-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/team
